name: Nhan Hoa Cloud VPS
description: Client-facing REST routes for a Nhan Hoa (Nhân Hòa) Cloud VPS service: read identifiers, live status, and control actions (power/reinstall/console are managed in the Nhan Hoa panel).

category.name: Nhan Hoa Cloud VPS
category.description: Nhân Hòa Cloud VPS resold through this installation

GET /service/@id/nhanhoa_cloud/info.name: Service Info
GET /service/@id/nhanhoa_cloud/info.description: Stored Cloud VPS identifiers (cloud id, order, plan, IP, status, expiry). Credentials are never returned.

GET /service/@id/nhanhoa_cloud/status.name: Service Status
GET /service/@id/nhanhoa_cloud/status.description: Live status/expiry pulled from Nhan Hoa (get_infocloud) and mapped to a HostBill status.

POST /service/@id/nhanhoa_cloud/power/@a.name: Power Control
POST /service/@id/nhanhoa_cloud/power/@a.description: Power action (start/stop/reboot). The Nhan Hoa Cloud API has no power command; returns a panel-managed notice.

POST /service/@id/nhanhoa_cloud/reinstal.name: Reinstall OS
POST /service/@id/nhanhoa_cloud/reinstal.description: Rebuild/reinstall OS. The Nhan Hoa Cloud API has no reinstall command; returns a panel-managed notice.

GET /service/@id/nhanhoa_cloud/console.name: Console / VNC
GET /service/@id/nhanhoa_cloud/console.description: Returns the Nhan Hoa panel deep link for console/VNC access (the API exposes no console command).
